chunks: And from him, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Sama'ah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"Eating before going out on the day of Eid, and if you do not eat, there is no harm."
ai.seo_question: Is it mandatory to eat before going to the Eid prayer?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on Eid prayers, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the flexibility of the Sunnah regarding pre-prandial consumption on Eid days. It confirms that while eating beforehand is recommended to distinguish the day from fasting, it is not obligatory, thereby removing any anxiety for those who omit it. This reflects the Shia jurisprudential principle of ease (yusr) in acts of worship that are not strictly mandated.
